question: Does an existing supported FRW path republish the source receipt for a changed subset of source files, so that activation needs no new admission delta?
answer: It republishes only as a full composition from the donor, not as an incremental update of an installed tree. Activation of the three-file repair therefore still requires either a full re-compose or a narrow explicit delta.

evidence.mechanism: scripts/friday_native.py -> complete() -> scripts/friday_install.finish_install(), which writes a fresh FRIDAY-INSTALL.json and install-stamp.json; _continue_cli_source() rewrites hermes-agent.source.json and replaces it by os.replace after composition_checked
evidence.receipt_builder: scripts/friday_install.source_checked + composition_checked regenerate the inventory from donors['hermes'], the pinned upstream tree and overlay manifests
evidence.why_not_incremental: source_checked requires every file currently on disk under hermes-agent/ to be either in the freshly composed inventory or in a fixed generated allowlist. A hand-edited subset is rejected as unexpected_composed_source_file; the receipt is regenerated from the donor, not read from the working tree

consequence_for_the_two_verdicts.old_receipts_not_rewritten: satisfied — old receipt files stay byte-identical; a new composition would produce new files with their own evidence
consequence_for_the_two_verdicts.service_implementation_and_guard_bound: still UNBOUND in PACKAGE.json and still requires binding to actually verified implementations; no receipt regeneration supplies those two fields

options.what: run the existing operator install/start phases so the composition is rebuilt with the three repaired files in the donor/overlay set
options.covers: composition identity, receipt publication, native proof, service binding — all from the product's own process
options.cost: full native rebuild; needs a fresh operator_entry input whose project_files/layers include the repair; requires a preceding stop of the running gateway
options.owner_action: approve one full native rebuild window, or supply an input that carries the three-file delta

options.what: one explicit addition to the existing friday_ordinary_gateway.invocation admission: an owner-controlled manual update role with its own evidence
options.covers: admits the manual path and preserves every existing refusal
options.cost: touches the product's admission code, so it is itself a product change requiring regression
options.owner_action: none beyond the already-given authority path

recommendation: NARROW_DELTA first, because it unblocks the manual path without a full rebuild and without weakening any refusal; a full re-compose remains available for the later proof-of-composition step already listed in BINDING.json remaining_after_authority.
still_required_by_either_option: binding service_implementation and refresh_boundary.guard_module to verified implementations
safe publication followed by confirmed gateway reload and verification in the original conversation
